integrity: Self-contained exact argument with standalone finite-check program; exhaustive tests through eighteen steps and rational comparisons through n=50; external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple symmetric bridges, not general renewals or arbitrary increments. Positive-excursion semiduration is half the total physical duration of all positive-sign excursions, not pointwise occupation. Formula-level enumeration is in Serlet (2014); historical novelty of the comparison theorem is provisional due to broad renewal-ordering literature.
title: More returns shrink the time-sampled excursion: an exact likelihood-ratio law
